key_idea: Linearity of expectation over directed edges of the shoelace formula: edge i->j appears iff both ends are chosen and none of the vertices strictly between them is.
sketch: Probability for a gap of g skipped vertices is C(n-2-g, k-2)/C(n,k), computed with lgamma to avoid overflow. Expected area = 1/2 |sum_i cross(p_i, sum_g pr[g]*p_{i+1+g})|, O(n^2) = 6M operations. Take the absolute value since the input is clockwise. Stop the inner loop once the probability becomes zero (fewer than k-2 vertices left). Verified against enumeration of all subsets for small n.
